messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novatech.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO ops onboarding & kickoff: Novatech — MAP and checklist

Liam / team —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the pilot. I want to get a short procurement onboarding call on the calendar this week to align the mutual action plan (MAP), confirm the PO process and timeline, and collect the onboarding documents so we can enable Novatech in our Dedicated environment without delays.

Proposed agenda (30 minutes):
- Quick introductions (5m) — owners and approvers
- MAP walk-through (10m) — key milestones and acceptance criteria
- PO & billing flow (5m) — PO number timing, invoicing cadence, tax docs
- Onboarding checklist & action items (5m) — who provides what, sample timelines
- Next steps & calendar owners (5m)

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed 5/5 10:00–10:30
- Thu 5/6 14:00–14:30

I attached our vendor onboarding form and a starter MAP workbook. Please: 1) confirm which time works, 2) share the best billing contact and PO cadence (one-time PO vs monthly); and 3) upload your W-9 or tax equivalent if you have one ready.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, initial_MAP_novatech.xlsx

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: +1 415-555-0182

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference platform

Subject: Re: PO ops onboarding & kickoff: Novatech — MAP and checklist

Evelyn —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Thu 5/6 14:00 PST works for our side (I'll join with our finance lead, Priya Shah).

A few notes in advance so we can be efficient on the call:
- We'll need a sample invoice and the billing address format to ensure our AP system accepts the invoice (our AP team uses exact address + tax ID).
- We can provide the W-9; I'll attach it to this thread by EOD (if not, I will bring it to the call).
- For the MAP: can you include expected SLA/latency targets and a checklist for data handling (we're regulated in our EU business, need to confirm data residency options)?

Also copied our procurement inbox (procurement@novatech.com) — they will own the PO issuance.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Vendor Partnerships | Novatech
liam.oconnor@novatech.com | +1 646-555-0107

Subject: Re: PO ops onboarding & kickoff: Novatech — MAP and checklist

Hi Liam — great, thanks for confirming Thu 5/6 14:00 PST. Calendar invite sent to all.

I've attached a pared-down PO process doc and our vendor onboarding checklist. For the call, we'll cover:
- Required forms: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (attached), W-9/tax form, bank details for ACH setup
- PO timing: Redwood typically requires a PO number before the first invoice; for pilots we can accept a preliminary PO and finalize on kickoff completion.
- Acceptance criteria for MAP: feature gating (pilot success metrics), go/no-go review, and sign-off owners (Product & Finance).
- Data residency note: Our Private deployment options and region routing are available — Karthik will speak to EU controls.

Attachments (stubs):
- vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable)
- redwood_po_process_v1.pdf (flow chart + sample invoice)
- initial_MAP_novatech.xlsx (starter MAP — please add target dates)

Action items before the call:
1) Novatech: return vendor_onboarding_form + W-9 (procurement@novatech.com)
2) Redwood (Soojin): prepare sample invoice and list of required billing fields (attached)
3) Karthik: prepare short note on EU data options and EU point of contact
4) Aditya: bring contract timeline and SLA bullets for the pilot (to confirm with legal)

If anything on the checklist is unclear, flag it here and I'll update the doc. See you on Thu.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick responses. Recap and next steps: 
- Meeting: Thu 5/6 14:00–14:30 PST (invite in your calendars)
- Novatech to upload vendor_onboarding_form.pdf + W-9 to procurement@novatech.com or reply-all to this thread by EOD Fri 5/7
- Redwood owners: Soojin (vendor ops) will bring sample invoice and PO flow; Karthik will cover EU controls; Aditya will cover contract timeline

If procurement@novatech.com needs a different time or wants finance-only pre-call, let us know and we'll accommodate. Looking forward to getting this across the finish line.
